'''Maria Ruzafa Lozano''' (born 7 August 1998) is an Andorran [[footballer]] who plays as a [[Forward (association football)|forward]] for Greek club [[AO Rethymniaki Enosi Athliton|REA]] and the [[Andorra women's national football team|Andorra women's national team]].

==Club career==
Ruzafa has played for ENFAF in Andorra, for Águilas in Spain and for [[Ternana Calcio|Ternana]] in Italy.

==International career==
Ruzafa has been capped for the [[Andorra women's national football team|Andorra national team]], appearing for the team during the [[2019 FIFA Women's World Cup qualification (UEFA)|2019 FIFA Women's World Cup qualifying cycle]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.worldfootball.net/team_performance/andorra-frauen-team/frauen-wm-quali-europa-2017-2018/ |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190830193146/https://www.worldfootball.net/team_performance/andorra-frauen-team/frauen-wm-quali-europa-2017-2018/ |url-status=dead |archive-date=30 August 2019 |title=Women World Cup Qualifiers Europe 2017/2018 » Teams (Andorra) |website=WorldFootball.net |access-date=29 August 2019}}</ref>

On 16 February 2022, she scored her first international goal against [[Gibraltar women's national football team|Gibraltar]] in a friendly match.
